What happened this morning. While the PHP regression sweep for 1c was running, the cloud workspace that held the test copy and the whole test harness was reclaimed and reset. The live system was never touched (1c has never been on it); every deployed kit, backup and document is safe on your machine and in this conversation. What was lost is the working copy and the harness built over the previous sessions: the 93 PHP suites and the 38 screen suites, with their fixtures.

What was done instead. A new test copy was rebuilt from the live files (a read-only archive of the app, taken this morning) and the safe backups (the schema snapshot, the 2024 legacy data, the 2026 master data and this morning's TourFlow copy), with the real Avenir application running against that copy rather than a mock. The 1c changes were re-applied, the same set as before and nothing new. New screen and PHP checks were written against the real application and run on it; the earlier PHP run is reported below exactly as it stands: interrupted, not completed.

Why this is enough for this release, and where it is not: the seven files are views and one comment; no controller, library, SQL or route changes, so the PHP logic the old battery exercised (installer, quotation engine, costing, allocation, payments, tickets, rollback kits) is not touched by 1c. What the old battery would have added is a regression net over that logic; that net needs rebuilding, and it should be rebuilt on your machine so it survives a workspace reset (see Incomplete).

8 Recommendation

1c is ready to go live when you say so. It changes seven presentation files and nothing in the database; every user keeps exactly today's access; the rollback is ROLLBACK.bat and takes seconds; the retest on a faithful copy of the live application found no failure in 67 screen checks and the PHP-side checks. The one thing missing is the broad regression net, which 1c does not touch and which would have run against logic 1c does not change. I would not hold 1c for that, but I would rebuild the battery before the next release that touches controllers or data.

If you approve, the go-live follows the steps in the kit's GO-LIVE.txt: read-only checks, an app-folder backup into a new folder under writable\ (never into tf_backups), the kit copied to writable\tf_releases, REAPPLY.bat, the seven files read back by checksum, then the screens opened once. No Install now, no log-out needed, no email, no data. Until your instruction, nothing moves.
